pitfalls: Closeout took four remediation cycles; the next person should know: (a) never run verification_evidence_refresh_stale or any checklist mutation while a review inventory epoch is OPEN - it moves the scope digest and voids every lane (RI-117 incident); (b) issue acceptance basis/pre-review only AFTER the scope contract is stable - a later scope_contract_acknowledge re-stales them (F-479); (c) the replay campaign binds HEAD and dev-memory appends are non-admissible drift, so land dev_memory_capture/finish_decision BEFORE the campaign; (d) done-required environment digests include TRACEPARENT which varies per shell invocation - earn and check must share one process tree; (e) story_advance has a flat 900s budget the 116-command suite exceeds - store a standalone validate PASS first.
